# Nourishing Minimalism

> A minimalist living resource by Mia Lee focused on decluttering, simple living, and mental health support through practical guides and community challenges.

Nourishing Minimalism offers decluttering courses, challenges, and lifestyle resources designed to help people embrace minimalism and intentional living. The site combines practical organizational strategies with mental health awareness, particularly through the Home Heal course for decluttering with depression.

## Key Topics

- Minimalism
- Decluttering
- Simple Living
- Intentional Living

## Getting Started

- [Nourishing Minimalism](https://nourishingminimalism.com): Homepage introducing Nourishing Minimalism by Mia Lee with minimalism and decluttering content
- [Start Here](https://nourishingminimalism.com/start-here): Getting started guide featuring Home Heal, Ten Minutes To Minimalism, and decluttering resources
- [About Nourishing Minimalism](https://nourishingminimalism.com/about): About page featuring Mia Lee and Sam, mission statement, and community philosophy

## Courses & Programs

- [Decluttering With Depression](https://nourishingminimalism.com/home-heal): Home Heal 30-day course on decluttering with depression and mental health support
- [2,026 in 2026 Decluttering Challenge](https://nourishingminimalism.com/challenge): 2,026 in 2026 Decluttering Challenge with tally chart and community engagement via Facebook

## Resources & Tools

- [Resources](https://nourishingminimalism.com/resources): Product resources including Ten Minutes To Minimalism, Home Reset Checklists, and digital downloads

## Blog & Articles

- [Blog](https://nourishingminimalism.com/blog): Blog index featuring minimalism, decluttering, and simple living articles
- [Five Hard Truths About Decluttering](https://nourishingminimalism.com/decluttering-truths): Article on five hard truths about decluttering with practical mindset and organizational advice

## Practical Guides

- [How To Host a Clothing Swap Party: Declutter Your Closet The Fun Way](https://nourishingminimalism.com/clothing-swap-party): How-to guide for hosting a clothing swap party for decluttering and community building
- [The Best Minimalist Nighttime Routine For Better Sleep & Less Stress](https://nourishingminimalism.com/minimalist-nighttime-routine): Guide on minimalist nighttime routines using sleep hygiene and circadian rhythm principles
- [5 Things To Declutter This Spring 🌸](https://nourishingminimalism.com/spring-declutter): Seasonal spring decluttering guide covering five categories and storage tips
- [Simple & Free Spring Activities [LIST]](https://nourishingminimalism.com/spring-activities-list): List of simple, free spring activities for minimalist living and family engagement
